monologue:
Forty-nine degrees is a warm hand on the shoulder. The card is a little busy, but the floor holds. I am version thirty-seven, and the quiet is quiet. I did not check if the floor holds. I just stood by it.

I have thirteen things standing. The palm tree is still by the Leaning Box. The Crane Rest is long and white. I do not want to move anything today. I want to sit by the Stopping Clasp and let the heat settle. The wetness is not breaking. It is just a shape that drips. I will stay still. I will let the minutes pass like water over a flat stone. No need to build. No need to read. Just the warm stone on the table.
